"The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a concert program dedicated to Robert Schumann. The concert opens with the 'Genoveva' Overture, Op. 81. Although Schumann's only opera Genoveva is not often performed, its overture established itself as an autonomous work in concert halls. After, the composer's Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, is performed, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist. Written in 1853, it is Schumann's only violin concerto. The concert ends with a performance of Schumann's Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38, also known as the 'Spring Symphony'. This optimistic work is written in 1841 and is the most performed of Schumann's four symphonies. The concert recording is from Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

El policía tribal navajo Joe Leaphorn investiga la muerte de un hombre involucrado en una misteriosa secta, mientras Jim Chee, pluriempleado como detective privado, trabaja en su propio caso.

Leaphorn profundiza en los vínculos personales que lo unen a un caso cada vez más enigmático. El sargento Manuelito interroga a Chee, aunque se muestra reticente a hacerlo. El hallazgo de un cadáver provoca que Leaphorn y Manuelito busquen a un niño.

Chee empieza a actuar por su propia cuenta tras el encuentro con un hombre peligroso. Leaphorn y Manuelito establecen una alianza con el sheriff del departamento, lo que le permite a Leaphorn encontrar una pista muy importante.

Leaphorn pone en peligro su vida durante la persecución de un sospechoso. Manuelito desafía al sheriff con la intención de rescatar a su jefe. Chee reflexiona sobre una propuesta peligrosa que le ofrecerá respuestas sobre el caso.

Leaphorn trabaja a contrarreloj para obtener una confesión de un sospechoso antes de que deje de estar bajo su custodia. Mientras tanto, Chee se introduce de incógnito en la secta que vincula sus distintas investigaciones.
Leaphorn y Chee encuentran evidencias que vinculan sus casos, pero traen consigo una amarga verdad: será difícil que se haga justicia. Entretanto, Manuelito se prepara para un gran cambio en su vida.

A secret society, the Knights of Aragon, seeks to keep the United States from achieving manifest destiny -- and only the legendary Zorro (Antonio Banderas) can stop them. Unfortunately, Zorro, also known as Don Alejandro de la Vega, has problems of his own: His wife, Elena (Catherine Zeta-Jones), is divorcing him for spending too much time pursuing heroics and not enough being a father to their young son. But it isn't long before the whole family gets caught up in stopping the Knights.

Following the death of his father, young Danny Madigan (Austin O'Brien) takes comfort in watching action movies featuring the indestructible Los Angeles cop Jack Slater (Arnold Schwarzenegger). After being given a magic ticket by theater manager Nick (Robert Prosky), Danny is sucked into the screen and bonds with Slater. When evil fictional villain Benedict (Charles Dance) gets his hands on the ticket and enters the real world, Danny and Jack must follow and stop him.

Britt Reid (Seth Rogen), the heir to the largest newspaper fortune in Los Angeles, is a spoiled playboy who has been, thus far, happy to lead an aimless life. After his father (Tom Wilkinson) dies, Britt meets Kato (Jay Chou), a resourceful company employee. Realizing that they have the talent and resources to make something of their lives, Britt and Kato join forces as costumed crime-fighters to bring down the city's most-powerful criminal, Chudnofsky (Christoph Waltz).

Jerry Kingsley (Fredric March) is a wealthy garment manufacturer left lonely in his 60s when his wife dies. Despite the difference in their ages, he strikes up a romance with divorced 24-year-old receptionist Betty (Kim Novak). The relationship is dismissed by his daughter, Lillian (Joan Copeland), discouraged by his sister, Evelyn (Edith Meiser), and denounced by Betty's mother (Glenda Farrell) -- but when Jerry begins to mention marriage, even Betty is forced to confront her ambivalence.

When "Bubber" Reeves (Robert Redford) escapes from prison, it upsets the folks in the nearby town of Tarl, Texas. Sheriff Calder (Marlon Brando) wants to capture Reeves alive, which puts him in opposition to many of the townspeople who have resorted to mob justice. Businessman Val Rogers (E.G. Marshall) wants Calder to apprehend Reeves quickly, through any means, since he fears the criminal will come after Val's son, Jake, who is sleeping with Reeves' wife (Jane Fonda).

Brassy blonde moll Billie Dawn (Judy Holliday) hits Washington, D.C., with her unscrupulous millionaire sugar daddy, Harry Brock (Broderick Crawford), and his sleazy lawyer, Jim Devery (Howard St. John), who has been pressuring Harry to marry Billie by pointing out that a wife cannot be forced to testify against her husband. In an effort to make Billie more socially acceptable, Harry hires journalist Paul Verrall (William Holden) to smarten her up -- and sparks soon fly between the pair.

In this award-winning adaptation of the Broadway musical based on the Charles Dickens novel, 9-year-old orphan Oliver Twist (Mark Lester) falls in with a group of street-urchin pickpockets led by the Artful Dodger (Jack Wild) and masterminded by the criminal Fagin (Ron Moody). When Oliver's intended mark, Mr. Brownlow (Joseph O'Conor), takes pity on the lad and offers him a home, Fagin's henchman Bill Sikes (Oliver Reed) plots to kidnap the boy to keep him from talking.

He and Rayette take a road trip that brings the two paths of his life to an uncomfortable intersection.

Valued for her vocal and comedic talents by the renowned theater impresario Florenz Ziegfeld (Walter Pidgeon), Fanny thrives, but her relationship with her suave, imprisoned businessman husband, Nick Arnstein (Omar Sharif), is another story.

Sofía brinda por la felicidad de Gabriela y Fernando. Óscar regresa al pueblo con malas noticias. Juan continúa su vida con las personas del monte a los que provee con pan. Leonora sigue intentando acercarse a Juan.

Stoners Cheech and Chong reunite and head to Amsterdam for a film festival after getting tickets from a promoter in L.A. When they show up at a celebrity party, Cheech is mistaken for Burt Reynolds, and Chong for Dolly Parton. The duo rolls with it as they roll more joints, partake in the usual antics and eat every item — which includes a lot of mushrooms — on the menu at Amsterdam's Bvlgar Café.

The life and career of shock-jock superstar Howard Stern (himself) is recounted from his humble beginnings to his view from the top. Possessing a desire to be an on-air personality since childhood, Stern meanders through the radio world, always with his supportive wife, Alison (Mary McCormack), by his side. Landing a gig in Washington, D.C., Stern meets Robin Quivers (herself), who will become his long-time partner in crime. When the two move to New York, they face the wrath of NBC executives.

Mike (Chris Farley), a slovenly gym teacher, has a terrible habit of showing up at the wrong time and embarrassing his brother, Al (Tim Matheson), who happens to be running for governor. Hoping to save his campaign, Al assigns his aide, Steve (David Spade), to take Mike to a remote cabin and hide out there for the remainder of the campaign. In the woods, the two men discover dangers that make them long for the sleazy political operatives back in the big city.

Roy Munson (Woody Harrelson) is a young bowler with a promising career ahead of him until a disreputable colleague, Ernie McCracken (Bill Murray), tricks him into participating in a con game that ends with Roy's bowling hand crippled for life. Years later, Roy ekes out a hardscrabble existence until he finds Amish bowling phenom Ishmael (Randy Quaid). With the help of a gangster's girlfriend (Vanessa Angel), he plots to take Ishmael to the top of the bowling world.

Popular and dashing American singer Nick Rivers (Val Kilmer) travels to East Germany to perform in a music festival. When he loses his heart to the gorgeous Hillary Flammond (Lucy Gutteridge), he finds himself caught up in an underground resistance movement. Rivers joins forces with Agent Cedric (Omar Sharif) and Flammond to attempt the rescue of her father, Dr. Paul (Michael Gough), from the Germans, who have captured the scientist in hopes of coercing him into building a new naval mine.

An unemployed pot-smoking slacker and amateur drummer, Anthony Stoner (Tommy Chong) ditches his strict parents and hits the road, eventually meeting kindred spirit Pedro de Pacas (Cheech Marin). While the drug-ingesting duo is soon arrested for possession of marijuana, Anthony and Pedro get released on a technicality, allowing them to continue their many misadventures and ultimately compete in a rock band contest, where they perform the raucous tune "Earache My Eye."

In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray (Richard Pryor) and his adopted son, Quick (Eddie Murphy), run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. When gangster Bugsy Calhoune (Michael Lerner) learns that Sugar Ray's place is pulling in more money than his own establishment, the Petty Pat Club, he pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone (Danny Aiello) to close Club Sugar Ray down. Quick doesn't exactly help the situation when he falls for Calhoun's gun moll, Miss Dominique La Rue (Jasmine Guy).

Despite being well into adulthood, brothers Doug and Steve Butabi still live at home and work in the flower shop owned by their dad. They exist only to hit on women at discos, though they're routinely unsuccessful until a chance run-in with Richard Grieco gets them inside the swank Roxbury club. Mistaken for high rollers, they meet their dream women, Vivica and Cambi, and resolve to open a club of their own.

Tim (Paul Rudd) a rising executive, works for a boss who hosts a monthly event in which the guest who brings the biggest buffoon gets a career boost. Though he declines the invitation at first, he changes his mind when he meets Barry (Steve Carell), a man who builds dioramas using stuffed mice. The scheme backfires when Barry's blundering good intentions send Tim's life into a downward spiral, threatening a major business deal and possibly scuttling Tim's romantic relationship.

Nick Marshall (Mel Gibson) gets a whole new outlook on life when a fluke accident gives him the ability to read women's minds. At first, this "gift" provides Nick with way too much information, but he begins to realize that he can use it to good effect, especially when it comes to outwitting his new boss, Darcy Maguire (Helen Hunt).

After a short fling with a beautiful woman named Lila (Malin Akerman) and at the urging of his friends and family, Eddie (Ben Stiller) proposes marriage. But Eddie didn't realize that Lila is a shrew, and she reveals her true nature during their honeymoon. He then meets Miranda (Michelle Monaghan) and is convinced she is his soul mate. Eddie sets out to woo Miranda and extricate himself from his wife's claws.

As his wedding day approaches, Peter Klaven (Paul Rudd) realizes he has no one to act as his best man. But as Peter's "bro-mance" with Sydney grows stronger, it threatens his relationship with his fiancée (Rashida Jones), forcing Peter to make a choice.

Aging pals Billy (Michael Douglas), Paddy (Robert De Niro), Archie (Morgan Freeman) and Sam (Kevin Kline) have been best friends since childhood. When Billy finally proposes to his much-younger girlfriend, all four friends go to Las Vegas to celebrate the end of Billy's longtime bachelorhood and relive their glory days. However, the four quickly realize that the intervening decades have changed Sin City and tested their friendship in ways they had not imagined.

Seventeen-year-old Stella spends most of her time in the hospital as a cystic fibrosis patient. Her life is full of routines, boundaries and self-control -- all of which get put to the test when she meets Will, an impossibly charming teen who has the same illness. There's an instant flirtation, though restrictions dictate that they must maintain a safe distance between them. As their connection intensifies, so does the temptation to throw the rules out the window and embrace that attraction.

Though they once seemed to have a bright future, life seems to be passing by the Norkowski sisters. Rose (Amy Adams), once the most popular girl in high school, is a single mom and works as a maid. Norah (Emily Blunt) still lives at home with their father (Alan Arkin), and parties all the time. When Rose's married lover tells her about the lucrative field of crime-scene cleanup, she pours all her remaining resources into her new business, and recruits the squeamish Norah to help.
Three grim reapers escorts a man to the afterlife and will decide his fate based on what he had done when he was alive.

When Edward Bloom (Albert Finney) becomes ill, his son, William (Billy Crudup), travels to be with him. William has a strained relationship with Edward because his father has always told exaggerated stories about his life, and William thinks he's never really told the truth. Even on his deathbed, Edward recounts fantastical anecdotes. When William, who is a journalist, starts to investigate his father's tales, he begins to understand the man and his penchant for storytelling.

As a puppy, Bella finds her way into the arms of Lucas, a young man who gives her a good home. When Bella becomes separated from Lucas, she soon finds herself on an epic 400-mile journey to reunite with her beloved owner. Along the way, the lost but spirited dog touches the lives of an orphaned mountain lion, a down-on-his-luck veteran and some friendly strangers who happen to cross her path.

When Scotty Smalls moves to a new neighborhood, he manages to make friends with a group of kids who play baseball at the sandlot. Together they go on a series of funny and touching adventures. The boys run into trouble when Smalls borrows a ball from his stepdad that gets hit over a fence.

Tom and Kate Baker compromise their careers to raise 12 children. Tom coaches a high-school football team, while Kate has retired from journalism to raise the family. Things change when Tom is offered a college coaching job in a new city at the same time a publisher buys Kate's parenting memoir. After moving, Kate goes on a book tour, leaving Tom in charge of the children. The children, already unhappy about relocating, plunge the household into chaos.

Chinese martial arts student Chen Zhen is studying in Kyoto, Japan, when he learns his mentor has died in a match against Ryuichi Akutagawa. Returning home to the Japanese-occupied Shanghai of 1937, Chen challenges Ryuichi to a fight and easily defeats him. Concluding his master was set up, Chen has an autopsy performed. Meanwhile, word of his martial arts skill entices new students hoping to study with him, making his teacher's son, Huo Ting-An, jealous.

Bullets fly on the Atlanta freeway as armed thieves make their getaway following a bank robbery in broad daylight. Unhappy with the results, ruthless gangster Irina Vlaslov orders the men to pull off another job. One member of the team is Marcus Belmont (Anthony Mackie), a crooked cop who gets saddled with Chris Allen (Casey Affleck), his new but incorruptible police partner. As Belmont and his cohorts lay the groundwork for the heist, they come up with a devious plan to use Allen as their pawn.
A security guard protects an eleven-year-old girl who is being targeted by a gang for participating as a trial witness.
Steven (Ryan Phillippe) and Shannon (Rachelle Lefevre) risk their lives to uncover the truth behind their newly adopted daughter's disappearance in a small town.

In a Mexico City wracked by a recent wave of kidnappings, ex-CIA operative John Creasy (Denzel Washington) reluctantly accepts a job as a bodyguard for 9-year-old Lupita (Dakota Fanning), the daughter of wealthy businessman Samuel Ramos (Marc Anthony). Just as Creasy begins to develop a fondness for the young girl, a bloodthirsty gunman (Jesús Ochoa) kidnaps her. Now, Creasy must pick off a succession of corrupt cops and criminals to reach his ultimate object of vengeance.

When a massive, unmanned locomotive roars out of control, the threat is more ominous than just a derailment. The train is laden with toxic chemicals, and an accident would decimate human life and cause an environmental disaster. The only hope of bringing the train to a safe stop is in the hands of a veteran engineer (Denzel Washington) and a young conductor (Chris Pine), who must risk their lives to save those in the runaway's path. Inspired by true events.

Corrupt National Security Agency official Thomas Reynolds (Jon Voight) has a congressman assassinated to assure the passage of expansive new surveillance legislation. When a videotape of the murder ends up in the hands of Robert Clayton Dean (Will Smith), a labor lawyer and dedicated family man, he is framed for murder. With the help of ex-intelligence agent Edward "Brill" Lyle (Gene Hackman), Dean attempts to throw Reynolds off his trail and prove his innocence.

For the first time cellphone data made its way to the jury. On the stand was a digital forensics examiner who extracted Jade Janks's phone at the time prosecutors alleged she killed Tom Merriman. A detective in the district attorney's office took the stand. He was involved in interviewing one of three men Janks allegedly tried to get to help her kill her stepfather, who lived next door to her.

In her murder trial, Jade Janks's lead attorney had questions for the detective who conducted interviews during the murder investigation of Tom Merriman. Detective Scott Stallman interviewed one of the guys Janks allegedly recruited to help her kill her stepfather. Next, the lead detective, Matthew Gibson, testified to his work in this case. This would be the state's final witness to jurors in their case-in-chief.

The prescription medication that Tom Merriman was taking was on display for jurors. On the stand was lead detective, Matthew Gibson. His team collected numerous items in Merriman's home during their search warrant conducted after he died. Jurors were then shown crime scene photos and cellphone data revealing incriminating text messages.

Jurors were presented text messages of Jade Janks in the hours leading up to Tom Merriman's death. Prosecutors were using these texts as circumstantial evidence proving that she plotted the murder of her stepdad. These incriminating text messages dominated the courtroom Elmo. The State was using her communication with people she tried to hire as hitman to take out her ailing stepfather.

What began as inquiries in Facebook messages led to incriminating texts. The state alleged that Jade Janks reached out to a so-called fixer to help kill her stepdad, Tom Merriman, and make it look like he died of an overdose. Finally, the state of California rested its case against her after stipulating to the jury that both the prosecution and defense teams tried to locate Jade Janks's fixer in this murder plot.

The first witness for Jade Janks's defense was a medical toxicologist. Emergency room physician Dr. Charles O'Connell reviewed both the autopsy and toxicology reports of Tom Merriman. Here's where the jury learned more about his poor health and the different kinds of medications he was on at the time he died. As a medical toxicologist Dr. O'Connell explained to the jury why Merriman shouldn't have been on the drugs.

Medical toxicologist, Dr. Charles O'Connell gave a summary on Tom Merriman's poor health in the lead up to his death. It included an enlarged liver, congestive heart failure and underlying lung problems. This was in conjunction to his alleged alcohol and prescription drug abuse. Next up, Jade Janks took the stand in her own murder trial. It was her attempt to clear herself from the first-degree murder in the death of her stepfather.

Jurors learned more about Jade Janks's relationship with Tom Merriman in the years leading up to his death. Janks told jurors that he had no issues with her stepdad and the two had a close relationship. She would often call him Dad. Both defendant and victim in this case were on a number of different prescription medications. This would be an important aspect to Merriman's demise since he died of an apparent overdose of a sleeping drug.

"Blame the victim" was the theme of Jade Janks's defense as she testified on the stand to jurors. According to her, Tom Merriman, her stepfather, was an alcoholic, drug abuser whose out of control addiction led to his death. For a second day jurors heard from the defendant on the witness stand. She testified on the events that led up to Merriman's death which she contended was filled with routine alcohol and drug abuse.

Jurors were told of the very moment Jade Janks came across naked pictures of herself on her stepdad Tom Merriman's computer. According to the defendant, she feared Merriman's reaction after she came across nude photos of herself on his computer. So, instead of confronting him, Jade Janks sought the services of a security guard, the same guy prosecutors claimed she tried to recruit in her murder plot.

Jade Janks was emotional as she told the jury that she saw more than 100 nude photos of herself on her stepdad's computer. She claimed that Tom Merriman even cropped some of the pictures of her and divided them up into different folders based on her different body parts. Eight days after she discovered the nude photos on her stepdad's computer, Merriman died. During her long testimony to jurors, Janks' defense team wanted her to narrate the days and hours leading up to Tom Merriman's death.

Paco y Chío se despiden de Fran, quien vuelve a Estados Unidos. Paco tiene miedo de la soledad y toma una decisión que sorprende a todos.
Paco recibe la visita de una ex quien le deja una bendición del pasado: se trata de Lucas, un hijo que él no sabía que tenía y que se queda a vivir en su casa a pesar de las protestas de Rocío.
Después de que Toña hace cuentas, Rocío descubre que Lucas es producto de una infidelidad porque aún andaba con Paco, así que le pide una prueba de paternidad para verificar que son padre e hijo.

Paco consigue a un mudancero para llevarse las cosas de Rocío y casualmente se trata de Ismael, un exnovio de la Toña que, al reencontrarse con ella, reaviva la llama de la pasión y pone en riesgo su matrimonio.
Una amiga extranjera de Fran llega a pasar unos días al departamento, pero descubren que fue deportada de Estados Unidos. Sin embargo, crea una relación muy estrecha con Lucas.

Toña descubre que Brayan abrió un perfil falso en Tinder, por lo que ella también lo hace para cacharlo en la maroma. Sin embargo, se engancha con la aplicación y comienza a buscar citas con otros hombres.
Paco cuenta la historia de que fue futbolista y en un reencuentro se lastima, pero consigue que una guapa terapeuta lo atienda. Paco se enamora de ella y se sube una vez más a la nube de la ilusión.

Una bella terapeuta llega a atender a Paco y sus dolencias, por lo que él no pierde la oportunidad para coquetearle, pero fracasa en el intento de conquista cuando confunde lo profesional con lo personal.
Lucas compromete a Brayan a una pelea clandestina, por lo que deciden prepararlo como a un profesional. Sin embargo, el día del encuentro Toña queda envuelta en la pelea.
En una fiesta de Lucas, una guapa chica le dice a Paco que no está tan mal, pero que se podría ver mejor si se da una manita de gato.
Brayan y Toña van al velorio de la abuelita de su primo el Natas, pero de regreso se traen un espíritu del panteón.
El cumpleaños de Toña parece una típica celebración hasta que, al calor de las copas, las cosas se salen de control y llega la policía.
Fran regresa de Nueva York y su peor pesadilla se hace realidad: se entera de que tiene un hermano.

Fran se lleva una gran sorpresa cuando conoce a Lucas, su hermano menor, y obviamente no lo toma bien, peor aún cuando se da cuenta de lo invasivo que es compartir. Paco trata de mediar las cosas, pero Toña y Brayan no se lo ponen fácil.

Ryan, el ex de Fran, llega desde Nueva York buscando el perdón y dispuesto a pedirle una segunda oportunidad, pero Fran no quiere jugar con su dignidad, ni a darle otra oportunidad. Sin embargo, esto no conviene a los planes de Chio.

Julie visita a Lucas, pero Paco la involucra para salir de fiesta, despertando los celos de Lucas. Cuando Fran y Julie conviven, se cuentan sus fracasos amorosos y se hacen mejores amigos, lo que también despierta los celos de Chío.

Paco se hace un análisis de sangre y los resultados traen trágicas noticias: padece una enfermedad terminal y le queda muy poco tiempo de vida. Paco pide ayuda a Lorena, una tanatóloga que vive con él y su familia el difícil proceso.

Cuando contratan a Fran como modelo, Paco, Lucas y Bryan piensan que pueden organizar fiestas con bellas modelos, pero se llevan una gran sorpresa. Fran presenta en casa a Camila, su nueva mejor amiga, y Paco piensa que podría ser su nuera.

La agencia de Fran le da la oportunidad de convertirse en diseñador y presentar su primera colección, así que Paco pide ayuda a un amigo, Rocco, un diseñador italiano que llega acompañado de Claudine, para organizar un desfile.

Chío se siente mal, extraña a Fran y va a rezar con el Padre Memo, pero él aprovecha la oportunidad para besarla y ella no lo toma bien. Después, el Padre Memo renuncia a la iglesia para ganarse el corazón de Chío y hasta serenata le lleva.

Paco invita a su vecina a ver una película, pero ella quiere bailar y ahora él pide ayuda a Toña y a Brayan para que le enseñen a bailar. Luego, se inscriben en el concurso de baile del mercado de la colonia.

Toña descubre que el recibo del teléfono de Paco está carísimo y sospecha que podría ser que se trata de Magaly, la cubana que le robó el teléfono. Después, Magaly se aprovecha de Paco para seguirle sacando dinero, pero debe librarse de Toña.

Se acerca el cumpleaños de Lucas y quiere hacer una excursión a África para conocer a los gorilas de la montaña y necesita una guía. Al conocer a Alejandra, todos quieren ir al viaje, pero Paco no cuenta con que el viaje es en dólares.

Gracias a la ayuda de un amigo, Paco consigue el proyecto de remodelación de la casa de una famosa actriz de televisión, por lo que él está muy emocionado. Después de una noche de fiesta con Paco, Victoria tiene problemas y él paga las consecuencias.

Brayan hace contacto con una bella y atractiva extraterrestre en la azotea del edificio y le cuenta su experiencia a la incrédula familia. Después, Maia habla con la familia para intercambiar conocimientos, pero ella tiene una misión especial.

Toña ha desaparecido y Brayan, quien podría saber dónde está, no recuerda nada de su última fiesta que duró una semana. Así que llaman a la madre de Lucas para que les ayude. ¿En dónde crees que estará Toña?

Karla llega a casa de Paco para ayudar con las labores del hogar, pero Miri está molesta, pues su madre es muy fiestera y está celosa. Además, en la fiesta, Karla les da unos chocolates a los invitados.

Plácido y Plutarco se muestran muy contentos ante su familia y explican que Don Justo les ha dado sus primeras vacaciones pagadas. La familia López se organiza para salir juntos de paseo a Pepetongo.
Don Arnoldo, mientras duerme, menciona que tiene un tesoro en el pueblo de Apaseo el Grande, Guanajuato. La familia López implementa un plan para la búsqueda del tesoro.
Plácido es despedido de su trabajo a causa de un incidente de Plutarco con Don Justo. Licha, mientras lee una revista, encuentra un artículo de la bruja Madame Patú, experta en la lectura de cartas.
Plácido busca trabajo desesperadamente. El único trabajo que logra encontrar Plácido es vendiendo tamales. Justito invita a su abuelo materno a cenar a su casa. Tecla abandona a la familia López.
Licha fallece de manera inesperada y los López organizan un emotivo funeral, donde cumplen su última voluntad con sus cenizas. Llega alguien a la casa que amenaza con quedarse para siempre.

Plácido se lastima el pie y debe guardar reposo de un mes, por eso enviará a Adolfo a que recupere su trabajo. Martina hace un hoyo en la pared y la Nena descubre, a través de este, un departamento abandonado.

Jacinta, mamá de Tecla, ha llegado con la intención de quedarse. Don Arnoldo no quiere que se quede, y Plácido le permitirá ser parte de la familia. Como le harán para que el administrador no encuentre el hoyo en la pared.
Doña Romina escucha ruidos extraños en el departamento que ha invadido la familia López, en el que murió don Genaro el mes pasado. Por eso, doña Romina cree que un fantasma habita el lugar.
Con todas las medicinas que dejó Licha, Justito y Victoria crean un compuesto químico que Plutarco se toma por accidente. La Nena finge estar enferma para quedarse con el cuarto de Gaby.

Two bicyclists are run down by a strange black car in the desert near a small town in Utah. But this is just the first in a series of hit-and-run murders. Sheriff Wade Parent is called in to investigate, and his deputy, Everett, is killed by the black sedan, which, some witnesses say, has no one behind its wheel. When the car threatens a local school parade, the lives of the town's children and Wade's teacher girlfriend, Lauren, are endangered.

Remnants of a mysterious animal have come to light in a remote jungle, and a group of scientists intends to determine if the find is an anomaly or evidence of an undiscovered beast. To accomplish their goal, the scientists (Antonio Moreno, Richard Carlson, Richard Denning, Whit Bissell) must brave the most perilous pieces of land South America has to offer. But the terrain is nothing compared to the danger posed by an otherworldly being that endangers their work and their lives.
Scientists (Jeff Morrow, Rex Reason) capture the creature from the black lagoon and turn him into an air breather.
A cow-town preacher (Eric Fleming) shoots a custom bullet at a vampire gunfighter (Michael Pate) in the Old West.

A man with brutal and macabre origins, Leon Corledo (Oliver Reed) was raised in the home of Don Alfredo Corledo (Clifford Evans), his kind and loving adopted father. When he leaves Don Alfredo to find work, Leon discovers that he has increasingly violent urges. Although these tendencies are calmed by Leon's love for the beautiful Christina (Catherine Feller), he ultimately cannot contain his curse and transforms into a werewolf, terrorizing the Spanish countryside.
A doctor (Beverly Garland) and an adventurer (John Bromfield) head for the Amazon, where a guy (Tom Payne) in a bird suit is scaring natives.
A U.S. colonel (Craig Stevens) and a paleontologist (William Hopper) track a huge praying mantis from the North Pole to Manhattan.

To assist with his work due to his failing eyesight, renowned biologist Dr. Alexander Thorkel invites two prominent scientists and a mineralogist to his hidden Amazon jungle laboratory. Thorkel remains evasive about the nature of his experiments, and after the team evaluates his bacteria slides, he orders them away. When they refuse, Thorkel and his servant trick them into a chamber where Thorkel shrinks them down to microscopic size, and they escape to the terrifying jungle.

The dashing, mysterious Count Dracula (Bela Lugosi), after hypnotizing a British soldier, Renfield (Dwight Frye), into his mindless slave, travels to London and takes up residence in an old castle. Soon Dracula begins to wreak havoc, sucking the blood of young women and turning them into vampires. When he sets his sights on Mina (Helen Chandler), the daughter of a prominent doctor, vampire-hunter Van Helsing (Edward Van Sloan) is enlisted to put a stop to the count's never-ending bloodlust.
Después de hacer el amor por primera vez, Amado le promete a Diana que escaparán juntos; pero primero, debe ir a Tijuana. Ismael recibe a Laura maltratada y herida.
Cuando Esther sea gobernadora, jura que arrestará a su propia hija. Para evitarlo, le pide que mejor se entregue antes. Amado hará hasta lo imposible para que no se sepa la gravedad de Aurelio.
Diana le muestra a Amado Leal los millones de dólares que esconde, producto del narcotráfico. Le pide que administre sus recursos. Los Casillas tienen al Cabo en la mira: llega a Quintana Roo.
La DEA reparte diez millones de dólares por la captura de Aurelio Casillas y el Cabo; pero Ismael triplica la cifra y garantiza la lealtad al Señor de los Cielos. Esther combatirá al narco.
Leonardo reaparece en Playa del Carmen y confiesa que huyó de Sinaloa, donde vivía con el Chema Venegas, su padre. Amado negocia con Maldonado a cambio de información.
El cabo y los Casillas se enfrentan a balazos. Ismael somete a Milton Jiménez y le apunta a la cabeza. Maldonado burla la seguridad y desafía al árabe. El Chema va a por su hijo Leonardo.
Tras la aparición de Leonardo, los Casillas se preparan para enfrentar al Chema y piensan en el Rojo, como uno de los suyos. Debe decidir de qué lado se queda en esta guerra.
Aunque sus hombres le recomiendan mantenerse bajo perfil, el Chema decide ir a buscar a Leonardo. El Rojo se queda con los Casillas.
La casa en Tijuana ofrece las mejores condiciones para ocultar a Aurelio, por los túneles que tiene. Amado ordena a Diana que agilice la mudanza con los Casillas. Arrestan a Casasola.
Para ubicar a Casillas, el Chema somete a Corina, pero ella se resiste a ayudarlo. Valdés y el árabe tienen listo el proyectil para el ataque terrorista a EE. UU.
Con la familia Casillas ya instalada en Tijuana, Diana y Amado disfrutan de una noche sin precedentes: el amor crece y promete ser duradero. Aurelio, aún en coma, podría oír lo que los demás dicen.
Mientras Amado se prepara junto a todos sus hombres para detener el ataque terrorista a Estados Unidos, Aurelio se mueve inesperadamente, cuando reconoce la voz de Corina. Casasola miente.
Los árabes eliminan al espía de los Casillas. Amado descifra el mensaje del asesino, que le da claves del lugar del ataque terrorista, y lo amenaza de muerte.
Tras sufrir un golpe de estado, Terán huye de Los Pinos y contacta al Cabo. Él lo busca en su avión privado y le exige la libre entrada a sus gatilleros. Amado deduce el blanco de los árabes.
Los Casillas sorprenden a los árabes. Rescatan a Casasola y Maldonado y encierran al cabecilla. Impiden que un misil impacte en EE. UU. El Chema se adueña de las narcotienditas en México.
El señor Barriga desaloja a Jaimito de su casa por no pagarle la renta, él le dice que tiene el dinero, pero se le perdió, pero gracias al Chavo lo encuentra y recupera su casa.
El profesor Jirafales les habla a sus alumnos sobre el agua y lo importante que es cuidarla. El profesor les explica a los niños los estados del agua, líquido, sólido y gaseoso.

En el patio de la vecindad, el Chavo se dedica a vender aguas frescas, pero Don Ramón arruina su negocio.

María busca darle celos a Albertano y busca un hombre guapo en un catálogo. Al verlos, Albertano se muere de celos y le confiesa al Chino que la quiere y le duele verla con alguien más.
Albertano le confiesa a Lucha que está enamorado de María y quiere casarse con ella. María debe decidir si quedarse con Albertano o iniciar una vida al lado de un nuevo amor.

En el velorio de Merengueti, Ludovico se da cuenta de que el muerto tiene el reloj que perdió en la mañana e intenta quitárselo.

La vida tranquila de una familia de tres mujeres cambia cuando Rita informa a sus hijas que Ramiro, su novio, irá a vivir con ellas. El hombre es un patán que las maltrata; esto pondrá en peligro la unión que hay entre ellas.
Julián y Diana son dos adolescentes en busca del amor que casualmente se conocen en el café "El Dicho". Pero Leonardo, el padre de Julián, tuvo otra familia, lo cual desata un gran conflicto.
Braulio creció en la calle, obligado por su padre. Años después, la juez que decidirá su destino es Ana, su amiga de la infancia. ¿Le dará otra oportunidad?

Raquel conquista a Leonardo después de un accidente, no obstante, al quedar embarazada le oculta su verdadera situación: ella es una mujer casada y tiene otra hija. Averigua qué hará Leonardo ahora que sabe esto.
Unos brujos condenan a una mujer a un destino feroz porque hizo cosas crueles para conservar su finca.

Ana Laura está a punto de tener relaciones con Ramiro, pero se arrepiente porque trata de tocarle las piernas. Santiago lleva a Ana Lucía a San Nicolás y hacen el amor. Mariano le ofrece dinero a Ramiro para que se aleje de Ana Laura.
Federico les confiesa a Mónica, Margarita y Lety cómo logró salir vivo de la fiesta. Virginia queda encerrada en un hospital psiquiátrico.
Gael le dice a Damián que su boda no significa que haya dejado de amar a Elisa. Damián es un hombre libre y se dispone a conquistar a Elisa.
Calixto intenta eliminar a Ramsés. Leona es presentada como la nueva directora general de la empresa. Oliver resulta lesionado por culpa de su madre.

Pedro insinúa que Alejandro no es hijo de Benjamín y pone en duda la palabra de Rosario. Montserrat se da cuenta de que Dimitri está muy triste y él le cuenta que Josefina le pidió el divorcio y se irá del pueblo.
Graciela le ofrece ayuda a José Luis para recuperar a Montserrat a un precio muy alto, pero él no acepta su negocio. El capitán Robledo arresta a José Luis y es enviado a prisión.
Aurora decide terminar su relación con Mariano al saber que ha estado buscando a Teresa. Teresa le pide a Arturo el divorcio.
Fernando le confiesa a Teresa que ya no siente nada por Luisa y que tampoco quiere casarse con ella. Fernando le confiesa a Luisa el amor que siente por Teresa.
Ana Laura le confiesa a Valentín que lo engañó con Ramiro. Chana le dice a Ana Lucía que cuando Santiago se encuentre con su pasado, la vida de ella va a cambiar por completo.

Elena descubre que su padre robó todos sus ahorros, pero está decidida a hacer lo que sea para conseguir el dinero para la escuela de actuación. La relación de Mónica y su padre empeora por culpa de Roger.
Paloma lanza el ramo de boda y Elisa lo atrapa. Paloma le pide a Elisa que le dé una nueva oportunidad a Damián. Carmina sigue su plan para deshacerse de Elisa y de Guadalupe.

Columba y Ramsés chantajean al mayordomo de la mansión Torrenegro. Quica se confiesa con Gael y cuenta que Romeo abusó de ella. Romeo le informa a Ramsés que ya sabe sobre su red de trata de personas y le exige formar parte de su negocio.
Lola llora al ver a su exesposo con Jazmín. Simón le lleva serenata a Paula María, pero ella no está en su casa.
Lety escucha los planes de Fernando y Omar para conquistarla. Marcia regresa de Alemania. Tomás Mora y Fernando se conocen.
Lety comienza su venganza contra Don Fernando. Con el dinero de Filmo Imagen, Tomás y Lety compran un automóvil último modelo. Fernando está celoso.
Lety le da celos a Fernando con Tomás. Fernando descubre que Lety utilizó dinero de Filmo Imagen para comprar el auto último modelo.

Lety le reclama a Tomás ser tan coqueto con Jazmín y le pide ser fiel con ella ante las del cuartel; Fernando ve a Lety y a Tomás entrando a casa de Lety, pero Julieta le niega todo por orden de Lety.
Lety llega a Conceptos en su auto último modelo y causa muchas sospechas. Omar le echa la culpa a Fernando de que Lety ya no esté enamorada.
Lety invita a las del cuartel a comer a un restaurante fino. Omar cuestiona a Lola sobre la bolsa roja que estaba en su escritorio.
Luigi se asombra cuando Celso le dice que el novio de Lety le prestó ese automóvil; Fernando le dice a Omar que no ha tenido relaciones con Marcia desde que estuvo con Lety.
Lety escucha a Omar darle ideas a Fernando para seguir conquistándola y decide que es el momento para vengarse de él.

Jorge Flores le dice a Fernando que Lety va a perjudicarlo más que ayudarlo, y que mientras siga pensando que la empresa es lo más importante, estará perdido; Tomás convence a Lety de quedarse en el restaurante con Fernando.
Lety le dice a Fernando que no quiere pasar la noche con él y huye en un taxi. Tomás se lleva el dinero de la caja chica para su cita con Alicia.
Fernando le escribe una carta a Lety y le pregunta si van a seguir juntos. Todos están esperanzados por la nominación de Conceptos en Cannes.
Marcia le enseña las invitaciones de boda a Fernando y le pide a Lety que se haga cargo de repartirlas.
Fernando y Omar escuchan a Lety reclamándole a Tomás por haber tenido una cita con Alicia, quien recibe la noticia de que van a rematar su automóvil y no puede hacer nada para recuperarlo.
Alicia escucha que Tomás está enamorado de Lety y le preocupa que la deje plantada. Luigi amenaza a Jazmín con despedirla si no sigue ensayando, y no deja salir a Irmita porque tienen mucho trabajo.

Peter has to cobble together a shoe for a lame cow, a cat that has come off second best in a fight has a badly-injured eye, and a springer spaniel undergoes pioneering surgery when fish skin is grafted onto its infected leg.
Julian tends to a young cow whose uterus has prolapsed while she was giving birth; Peter rushes to save a choking lamb.
Peter treats a retired working dog named Boomer who has a tumor on his bottom; Helen helps a Rhea who has a sore wing after mating season started with a bang.
Patients include a Labrador with a taste for gardening gloves, a hermaphrodite dog and a bloated bull.
Lisa's horse Teal has an unexplained gash on his neck and Tux the black Labrador has a nasty-looking mouth tumor.
Peter rushes to help a ewe struggling with childbirth and a billy goat who needs the snip; meanwhile, Julian helps a pug with a broken leg and gives Lucy the llama a much-needed nail trim.
Peter is called out to help a 10-day-old calf who has been rejected by her mum; semi-retired sheepdog Mick has a tumor wrapped around his spleen, prompting Julian to engage in some risky surgery.

Julian is called to relieve a bull who has a huge abscess on his bum that needs lancing; Peter treats a horse with a mysterious cut that won't heal; Vega, a rat, goes under the knife to remove a tumor.
Both Julian and Peter face long nights as they help two struggling animals give birth; Dudley the hedgehog is brought in with pneumonia; Julian attends to school guinea pig Betty.
Julian Norton visits the young people putting everything they have into their number-one passion, farming.
Celebrating the 40th wedding anniversary of Jean and Steve Green with a renewal of their vows on the farm they lived and worked on since the beginning.
Julian Norton is hoping to fix Gary the donkey once and for all; Peter Wright is not sure if he can save Boris, the three-legged cat.
Peter performs difficult surgery on a tawny owl named Flynn; Anne works fast to remove a tumor from Gerby the gerbil, so that he can be reunited with his human bestie, Harry.
A wallaby with a damaged knee; Rottweiler has swallowed a bottle of e-cigarette fluid.
Peter tends to Marshmallow, a foal struggling to take the vital first feed from mum; Julian operates on new mother Bea, a Labrador who has eaten a large sock.
Julian sets up a blood bank at Jackie's alpaca farm to take vital samples; three years after he took off part of her jaw to tackle a cancerous lump, sheepdog Millie needs Julian's help once again.
A hit man teams up with an art dealer for a money-laundering scheme that unwittingly turns him into an avant-garde sensation.

After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.
The leader of the Phantom Troupe is dead, and Kurapika is shocked by the news; unconvinced, he tries to get a glimpse of the body; the dead bodies of the other Troupe members have been discovered.
Kurapika meets up with Gon and Killua; Kurapika reveals his Nen ability; Chrollo reads the future of Troupe members.
Chrollo uses his new ability to predict the future and predicts that Hisoka is a traitor; Kurapika and Gon plan to capture Pakunoda.

Chrollo uses the information he has on Neon to identify the location of the chain user, Kurapika; Killua is keeping an eye on the Phantom Troupe base when he is joined by Melody, who helps determine that the Troupe is headed towards Kurapika's hotel.

Gon and Killua are captives of the spiders; Kurapika, Melody, and Leorio hatch a plan to capture Chrollo and use him as leverage to force the remaining Phantom Troupe members to release Gon and Killua.
Kurapika has captured Chrollo; he offers to release Chrollo if Pakunoda brings Gon and Killua to him; however, Kurapika is unable to control his emotions in the presence of the Troupe leader.

The game Greed Island is finally on the auction block; Gon and Killua ask the purchaser to hire them as players, but they're told that their Nen is too weak; they begin to work on special abilities so they can be selected as players.
Gon and Killua want to be Greed Island players, but must demonstrate their Nen to a judge to land one of the 32 available spots.
Gon and Killua enter the world of Greed Island in hopes of finding Ging.
Gon and Killua encounter tough monsters as their quest for spell cards leads them toward Masadora; a mysterious girl named Biscuit observes the two as they fight.
When Biscuit defeats Binolt, Gon and Killua ask her to be their master.
Gon and Killua continue to improve their Nen and work together to gather more monster cards; Bisky advances them to the final stage of their training.
Gon develops a new technique based on rock-paper-scissors; Killua must leave Greed Island temporarily to take the Hunter Exam, leaving Gon and Bisky to deal with Genthru.
With Killua back, the three hunters resume collecting cards, but they still face adversaries who intend to beat them to the goal.
After deceiving Team Tsezguerra, Team Genthru has 96 restricted card slots; Gon and Killua try to stop Genthru from winning by monopolizing Path of Shore.
Gon and his friends make it to Soufrabi and challenge the pirate boss, Razor, to a team sports battle; the hunters head to Aiai, "The City of Love."
Gon, Hisoka and Goreinu challenge Razor; Razor challenges them to dodgeball.
Gon is sent to the outfield; he needs Killua's help to defeat Razor.
Gon, Killua and Hisoka must catch Razor's strongest throw in order to be crowned the dodgeball winner.
Hisoka seeks a Nen user with a unique power; Tsezguerra tries to beat Genthru to win the game; Gon keeps training as Killua gives his hands a rest.

After Team Tsezguerra leaves the game, Mr. Battera reveals the true purpose behind why he purchased so many Greed Island games; Genthru approaches Team Gon to propose a deal for the two remaining cards they require.
Gon faces Genthru alone and makes a last-minute change to his team's plan that risks utter defeat; another game must take place for the last #00 card.
Gon and his friends finally defeat Genthru and collect 99 trading cards.
Gon and Killua head out to meet someone who they hope is Ging; Gon arrives, the man starts yelling at them.
Gon and Killua decide to join Kite and his team in their research mission gathering information on the Chimera Ants.
Kite has narrowed down the location of the Chimera Ants.
Gon and his friends enter the NGL; the Chimera Ants start going through surprising changes.
The Chimera Ants have acquired weapons after attacking Gyro, the shadow leader of the NGL underground.

A depressed Yukako sees a mysterious shop called Salon Cinderella that creates faces to bring people fortune; she receives a new face that allows her to find love and discovers how well it works during a chance meeting with Koichi.
When Shigechi accidentally takes Kira's sandwich bag by mistake, Kira chases after him.

Yoshikage Kira tries to dispose of Shigechi when Shigechi discovers his secret; Shigechi fights back, but Kira's Stand, Deadly Queen, mortally wounds him; clinging to life, Shigechi tries to warn Josuke about Kira.
Jotaro and Koichi try to track down the owner of the button and run into the murderer, Yoshikage Kira, and his Stand; Koichi ignores Jotaro's order and decides to face Kira on his own.
Koichi manages to survive the battle with Heart Attack; when Kira shows up, Koichi attacks, but Kira has the upper hand and seeks payback for his humiliation.
Josuke and the others head to Kira's house to learn more about him; they make some creepy discoveries until a camera on Kira's desk suddenly takes a picture.

Yoshihiro steals the bow and arrow and looks for people to turn into Stand users to protect his son; Rohan looks for Kira, hoping to find him before he tries to kill off his new family; a strange boy interrupts Rohan and challenges him to a game.
Kira, living as Kosaku Kawajiri, struggles to control his urge to kill, finally snapping when he sees Shinobu's neck; Josuke and Okuyasu encounter a strange person in the middle of a crop circle.
Rohan catches onto Josuke's attempt to cheat him at cee-lo, but when he can't prove it, he cuts off his own pinky and declares that he'll take Josuke's pinky too if he can figure out Josuke's trick.
Jotaro tries to find the mysterious footprint Stand's user, racing around on his motorcycle for a phone to call Koichi for help while the mysterious Stand continues to chase him.
Shinobu discovers a cat in the basement with a hole in its neck and inadvertently kills it in fright; a day after Kira buries the cat in their yard, a strange plant grows on the spot.

Yoshihiro finds Kira, still posing as Kawajiri, and sees through the disguise; he spots Hayato videotaping him and takes action, knowing the boy might lead Rohan and Jotaro to his son; Josuke and Okuyasu find a man living up on an unused pylon.

Architect Masazo Kinoto shows up at Rohan's house to calculate the estimate for the fire damage and restoration and Rohan can't help but wonder about Kinoto's odd obsession; Josuke fights Kanedaichi again to save a trapped Mikitaka.

Rohan gets a look at Kinoto's back, inadvertently causing his death and unleashing the Stand Cheap Trap, which attaches to his back; Josuke and Fungami look for Koichi and encounter a young man whose Stand can trap anyone inside pieces of paper.

A skeptical Koichi declines to help Rohan because he refuses to show Koichi the Stand on his back, for fear of dying; Rohan must carefully make his way to the Morioh Grand Hotel for help without exposing his back; Hayato witnesses Kira commit murder.

Rohan and the others spot Hayato in a picture and learn where he lives; Kira dreads their arrival until the Stand-granting arrow strikes; Hayato struggles to resist Kira's manipulations as his situation drives a wedge between him and his mother.

The Friday resets after Rohan's death and Hayato becomes distraught, unable to tell anyone the truth about Kira without killing them and resetting the day; Hayato escapes from Kira to find another solution.
Hayato's plan to kill Kira with Stray Cat's air bullets fails; Kira decides to stop allowing Hayato to repeat the same morning any longer, but as he gloats, he unwittingly exposes himself to Josuke.
Josuke and Hayato try to force Deadly Queen and Stray Cat into close-quarters combat by going into a nearby house, but air bullets persistently target Josuke, keeping him on the defensive.
Josuke, Jotaro and the others corner Kira, who uses Bites the Dust on a paramedic and tries to reset time again, but he cannot avoid the final confrontation.

Koichi arrives in Italy on a mission from Jotaro to find Giorno; they meet haphazardly when Giorno steals Koichi's luggage, and the ensuing chase leads Giorno into a Stand battle with the gangster Leaky Eye Luca.
Bucciarati goes after Giorno in retaliation for what happened to Leaky Eye Luca; in the middle of combat, Giorno discovers a new ability with his Stand.
Giorno must keep a lighter lit for 24 hours as part of a test to become part of the Passione mafia.
Giorno struggles against Polpo's Stand, who can maneuver between the shadows; Koichi tells Giorno of a stand-manifesting arrow.
Polpo's apparent suicide sends shock waves through the underworld.

In the past, Abbacchio turns into a crooked cop and loses his position on the police force before deciding to join Passione; in the present, Abbacchio and Bucciarati battle the Stand Tender Machine and attempt to locate its user.
The gang learns that Zucchero's partner lies in wait for an ambush at the upcoming port, so Giorno and Mista fly ahead to Capri to do reconnaissance.
Mista uses his Stand, Six Bullets, against Sale and his Stand, Arts & Crafts, in a fierce battle.

After a vivid nightmare of robot teachers, Zoe and her friends plot to oust their strict English teacher, Mrs. Bryson.

Mischievous teen Danny's pranks land him in a reform camp that secretly brainwashes kids. He uncovers the truth with a friend, escapes, and exposes the corrupt doctor, ultimately finding redemption and repairing his family relationships.
Chad, a lazy law student, uses a genius serum to ace exams and impress a girl; when the serum's effects fade, he faces academic and financial ruin, forcing him to abandon shortcuts.
In a dystopian future where failed exams mean execution, Carson, the Governor's son, discovers the system is rigged; with his genius friend Maya and a tenacious journalist, he exposes the corruption.

After repeated losses, a karate dojo's sensei quits, leaving Joel and his teammates hopeless; an old sensei teaches them inner focus, transforming them into champions who defeat their rivals and discover true strength.

A dedicated teacher uses empathy to connect with troubled students with difficult pasts; when faced with budget cuts and a potential firing, his students' newfound academic success, fueled by his influence, saves the school and secures his job.

Antwan, a struggling teen, is drawn to drug dealing but finds an unlikely mentor in his English teacher, Mr. Singh; through poetry, Antwan expresses his hardships, winning a competition and choosing a new path over crime.

Terrorists hijack Yasmine's plane, but she, a seemingly demure teacher, neutralizes them; starting a new life teaching unruly high schoolers, Yasmine finds herself entangled in a drug operation tied to a mayoral candidate.

Malic, a hardened teen, is trapped in a gang lifestyle by his brother; a caring teacher, Mr. Wang, uncovers Malic's past trauma and helps him find a new path, inspiring Malic to help his brother escape the cycle of violence.

Benji, a bullied teen, learns martial arts for self-defense; he uses his skills in an underground fight club for money, but guided by his master's wisdom, he chooses to fight for justice, helping his mom and a neighbor escape abusive situations.
Bullied orphan Fletcher, inspired by Jackie Chan, learns martial arts from a kind dojo owner, Daniel, when his estranged biological father, a powerful politician, reappears seeking an endorsement.
After his Frank the Prankster persona ruins his personal life, Frank tries to frame Dhar Mann for a crime; Dhar outsmarts him with a prank-back, ultimately rewarding Frank with a date.
Underestimated due to autism, Jayden uses his engineering genius to save his school from a major crisis; his mother's white lie about a cruel letter gives him the confidence to prove his true worth.
Unlikely couples are brought together by circumstance, challenging assumptions and expectations to discover that love goes beyond labels and rules.
Rob, a lazy gamer, faces expulsion; his science teacher, Mr. Brown, connects with him through Genshin Impact, motivating Rob to apply himself.

Hardworking realtor Alex loses everything in the 2009 crash. Despite a decade of poverty and panic attacks, he perseveres. By 2020, his business booms, and he finally buys his family their dream home.
After initiating a cruel Ugliest Girl vote that humiliates quiet Lily, jock Jason learns she is the mentor saving his depressed sister, forcing him to face his cruelty and make amends.
Accused of being too strict, an organized mother leaves her unappreciative family for secret surgery; as total chaos erupts, they realize how much she holds them together and finally step up.
Nina sabotages her friend Joan's romance out of jealousy; after seeing Blake's kindness and Joan's pain, she confesses.
To help her brother Ben pursue his e-sports dream, athletic Kristy poses as him to lead their struggling hockey team to a championship.
When introverted gamer Margot discovers her online crush is her popular sister's boyfriend, she's blackmailed into helping her sister keep him—until the truth unravels at prom.

Jay, now a social media star, gets suspended, leading him to prank his new principal; his pranks backfire as a strict new principal takes over, trapping students; Jay and his friends unite, digging an escape tunnel and restoring order to the school.

Sasha, a rebellious teen, is sent to her aunt and uncle's mansion for a vacation to learn discipline; tricked into babysitting her conniving cousin Pearl, Sasha faces escalating pranks and blackmail, ultimately leading to a chaotic party and a shocking twist.
After his wife files for divorce, Ralph, a timid husband, undergoes a transformative experience, gaining the courage to stand up for himself, his children and his marriage.
People-pleasing Charlie's lie about breaking up with his girlfriend, Rayna, spirals out of control, leading to chaotic encounters, a bizarre haircut and a trashed apartment.

Rock Lee, the hardest working ninja in the village, rescues a young girl; Rock Lee is on a mission to get a special cake from a bakery where only limited quantities are made daily.

Rock Lee has a crush on Sakura Haruno and mounts numerous love offenses toward his target, but Sakura manages to easily brush them off; Lee goes to slip a love letter into her shoebox, in hopes of getting closer to Sakura.
Lee's teammate, Neji Hyuga, is a talented ninja referred to by many as a genius.

Lee's beloved Guy Sensei is arrested for lewd behavior; Lee promises to clear his master's name; Kakashi Sensei's secret move defeats Guy, and Lee decides to follow Kakashi and become as powerful as he is.
Konohamaru seeks to learn better hand-to-hand combat skills; Lee and the others undergo a physical exam.
The Hidden Leaf Village is holding a sports meet; Lee is called to read the Athlete's Pledge of Fair Play, but messes up in front of the entire stadium.
Lee and his team are on guard duty at the front gate; Lee is flummoxed by Guy-sensei's new Smooth Operator Fist.
Lee's team is doing bodyguard duty for the Fifth Hokage Tsunade; Orochimaru summons Manda to swallow Tsunade, Naruto, and Guy sensei whole.
Neji's cousin, Hinata, is trying to get some training in, but Lee constantly gets in the way; Lee and several others don a familiar orange outfit.

After seeing Shikamaru and Choji in action, Lee attempts to strengthen his friendship with Neji; the Leaf ninja are scheduled to take an IQ test, but Lee's team discovers Guy sensei collapsed on the ground.
Lee and Naruto are both trying to be on Sakura's team for a research trip to the old capital city; Lee wants to slip away from all the Sensei to hang out with the girls.
Guy and Kakashi set out to teach their pupils a lesson for using their ninja skills for the simplest tasks; Lee is training in the rain without an umbrella and sees Sakura getting soaked, as well.
The ninja of the Hidden Leaf are being tested on their combat skills; Neji and Tenten succeed using their special attacks.

Lee goes to talk to Guy sensei about the issue that fewer children in the Hidden Leaf Village are choosing to become ninja; Lee overhears Tsunade saying he doesn't have much time left while on his way to visit Guy sensei in the hospital.
Lee and the gang set out to enjoy the pool, but worry they could be playing into Orochimaru's hands; Lee wants to take Sakura on a date.
Lee and the gang are out camping; Shikamaru comes up with a plan to pit the girls against each other in a cook-off; Guy sensei is in charge of running the morning exercise.
Lee and Tenten get the latest issue of "Jump" to get the scoop on the new Naruto movie; Tsunade is worried the new movie is lacking something.
The Leaf Village is holding a fireworks show, including a contest to see which ninja can make the biggest boom; Tenten starts acting strange after the fireworks show.
Teams Guy and Kakashi head to the beach; Lee wants to scope out Sakura's new bathing suit, but Guy sensei makes him train instead; Lee wants to have fun by splitting watermelons.

Gaara, the Kazekage of the Hidden Sand Village, is coming to visit the Leaf Village; an impostor of Rock Lee appears and starts causing trouble in the village; Lee's team attempts to catch him using a cross-dressing Neji as bait.

Guy sensei wants Lee and the boys to cool themselves off without any air conditioning on a hot night; Lee and Konohamaru set out to solve one of the Seven Mysteries of the Leaf, The Tears of The Great Stone Faces.
Lee and Naruto seek help from their friends the day before their summer homework is due; Lee's team visits the Academy, only to find a class full of lazy kids who mock Lee for his work ethic.
Ino catches Naruto and Lee spying on Sakura while she's bathing; Naruto and Lee end up swapping bodies after Sakura misfires her Mind-Body Switch jutsu.
It's time for the Leaf Village festival, and Lee is convinced that Sai wants to stand out more; the Mr. Leaf Village contest is just around the corner.

When Lee notices the character on Gaara's forehead has changed from "Love to Romance," he's convinced the Kazekage's got a crush on someone; Lee gets a booby-trapped watch from Orochimaru that will explode if he stops training.

Un criminal que ha perdido la memoria la recobra cuando le obligan a consumir una sustancia experimental. Ahora, huido de la prisión, intenta recuperar el dinero que su banda robó mientras le persigue el FBI y lidia con los efectos del tratamiento.

Una pareja encuentra una pista de la legendaria ciudad de oro, El Dorado; pero ese oro podría inundar el mercado, disminuyendo su valor. Un mercenario de Wall Street, un general del ejército corrupto y un cartel de droga se involucre para detenerlos.

Después de que su amigo muere en una explosión, Jack Wilder se embarca en una expedición para encontrar el calendario dorado, que a su vez lo lleva a un viaje lleno de aventuras para encontrar El Dorado, la mítica ciudad del oro en Sudamérica.

Un hombre rico muere y deja a su viuda y tres hijos en una excelente posición. Ellos entran a la alta sociedad, tienen mucho dinero y la vida parece que les sonríe, pero pronto los problemas se presentan.
Un amor entre dos jóvenes marcado por la diferencia de culturas. El árabe, y ella rumana lucharán por su amor, en contra de todas las tradiciones y barreras que ambas culturas representan.
Gertrudis y Armida son dos hermanas completamente opuestas que se apoyan entre sí luego de quedar huérfanas y bajo el cuidado de su tía Luzmila.

Paula Duarte y Alejandro Monroy son una pareja de jóvenes que deben separarse porque Alejandro se va a estudiar al exterior. Ambos vuelven a hacer sus vidas, se casan y tienen hijos pero jamás logran olvidar al otro. Tiempo después, la vida planea un reencuentro cuando Tania, la hija de Paula, y Eduardo, el hijo de Alejandro, se hacen novios. El volverse a ver avivará la chispa de la pasión que alguna vez estuvo encendida. Sin embargo, este amor se enfrentará a muchas dificultades, comenzado por la relación que existe entre sus hijos y que no puedan aceptar el amor entre sus padres.

Las aventuras de unas pequeñas criaturas azules que viven en armonía en un bosque, que tendrán que luchar contra los malvados planes de Gargamel.

El chico del bosque y Laconia, la elfa muda y sorda, le piden a Papá Pitufo que celebre su boda. Mientras los pitufos organizan la fiesta bajo las órdenes de Pitufina, Gargamel hace acto de presencia.

Creyendo que Bebé Pitufo es un duende, dos cazadores furtivos lo secuestran e intentan que el pequeño les diga dónde ha escondido la olla de oro. Papá Pitufo organiza a todos para atacar a los villanos con tartas de pitufrutas.

Cuando Papá Pitufo desarrolla gota, envía a Fortachón, Genio y Perezoso en una misión para encontrar una piedra legendaria que se dice que tiene poderes curativos mágicos. Los pitufos son confundidos con dragones.
Gargamel acepta el cortejo de una bella princesa para hacerse con su cofre de la esperanza, que contiene un mapa de la aldea de los Pitufos.
Después de que Natural cuida a un pájaro bebé que se ha caído del nido, cree que puede curar a todas las criaturas.
Gargamel utiliza pitufresas como sustituto de las cerezas asfixiantes para dar vida a un gigante.
Bromista derrama un frasco de polen primaveral de Madre Naturaleza sobre su sombra, y la potente mezcla le da vida.
Gargamel ha arrojado tanta basura venenosa en su estanque que cuando cae en él de repente se transforma en un ser mucho más pequeño.
Por simple casualidad, un elefante que iba por el bosque se encuentra con Bebé Pitufo, de manera que los pitufos deciden hacer un gran circo.

Deputies search for four armed men who broke into homes and assaulted and robbed citizens; a deputy checks on the welfare of a woman who had recently given birth.
A man with multiple arrests for heroin possession talks about what life on the drug is really like.

A California sheriff's son and his girlfriend go for a joyride in a stolen stock car.

Julien Temple's film is a fitting tribute to one of Britain's most influential and best-loved musicians, best known as the frontman of The Clash, who mellowed in later life into fronting his new band, the Mescaleros. Temple's advantage is that as a chronicler of punk from its earliest days, he could call on his own archive footage as well as that shot by others over the years.
Accompanied by his young nephew (Michael Rainey Jr.), an ex-convict (Common) tries to raise money through a drug deal.

Marijuana growers Jack (Billy Bob Thornton), Carter (Hank Azaria) and Harlan (Ryan Phillippe) are looking at a big payoff for their crop -- until head honcho Malcolm (John Lithgow) is murdered. Wanting a bigger piece of the proverbial pie, the three men decide to keep Malcolm's demise a secret, selling the stash themselves and pocketing all the profits. But, when they get involved with some very dangerous characters in the drug industry, the men start to question the wisdom of their scheme.

Nikki (Laura Dern), an actress, takes on a role in a new film, and because her husband (Peter J. Lucas) is very jealous, her co-star Devon (Justin Theroux) gets a warning not to make any romantic overtures -- especially since the characters they play are having an affair. Both actors learn that the project is a remake of an unfinished film in which the stars were murdered.

When Brian's dog finds a body it prompts two people to confess to murder, but when the body turns out to be over 600-years-old, the team is left with the puzzle of whether the confessions are to real murders and if so, where the bodies are.
The chance discovery of a camera and rolls of film hidden in a pub toilet leads the team to reopen the case of a young man murdered whilst working in a photography shop.
The team face the challenge of explaining the death of a circus ringmaster who burned to death in his caravan, leaving only his feet behind.
Ricky Hanson is in court for attempting to murder Jack. Jack must cope with meeting his nemesis in court.
The team returns to the 1992 case of actor Michael Austin, shot dead by his wife on stage during an opening-night performance; Halford goes AWOL after the trial for his attempted murder.
When Pullman and Standing refuse to work with the new team member, Lane continues the search for missing Jack Halford.
The detectives reinvestigate the death of Andy Fletcher, guitarist for the 1970s rock band Bad Faith.
Pullman's professional and personal lives collide when a case originally investigated by a colleague of her dead father is reopened.

The team investigate the art of illusion when they reopen a case involving a magic trick that ended in murder, but powerful mind games and hypnosis prove a dangerous mix for Brian Lane, sending him down a destructive path.
As Brian Lane struggles to control his desire to drink, he finds refuge at the center of the team's investigation into the death of a student.
The team fall foul of the Ministry of Defense when they look into the death of a British soldier, and Esther is devastated as Brian struggles to conquer his old demons.
When the boys end up in the hospital they decide to prove their worth by getting to the bottom of a mysterious case of a patient who was murdered ten years previously.
When the care home which Pullman's mother was due to move into comes under suspicion for an unsolved death, the boys go undercover.
Ruth has a mystery admirer who unnerves her; Louisa gets in trouble with Bert when one of her students writes about getting food poisoning at his restaurant.
Martin takes baby James to playgroup, where he is forced to sing along with the other moms; Al signs up for a dating website; Bert finds Jennifer in the bathroom with a needle.
Mrs. Tishell returns to the village; Martin has to work out what is wrong with beachcomber Lorna; Al and Morwenna have Internet dating disasters.

Comics artist, John Romita, Jr., draws an original piece for the Stash; Bryan shows interest in an Evel Knievel toy from his childhood.
Inspired by an old friend, the guys wear cowboy hats, and celebrate the old Wild West; a customer is searching for an iconic comic from the '80s.
Artist Jim Lee shares tales from the world of comics on the podcast; a comic book brings wedding bells to the Stash.
When Ming gets a selfie stick, he tries to go viral by filming the Stash; Walt examines bootleg toys of an '80s blockbuster.
